name: e2e_v14_h140
description: Blind long-term-memory gate for a 王者荣耀 companion chatbot: 10 ordinary Chinese players (student, retiree, self-employed, workers, parents; ages 16-62) with 11-12 casual sessions each over 2025-12..2026-10. Ranks, main heroes, phones, jobs, homes, pets, hobbies and relatives' situations change over time, some several times; the assistant makes varied concrete promises. Per player 16 questions: 5 facts (>=2 about other people, >=1 mentioned in passing), 3 updates (current value; stale_any = all outdated values), 3 trajectories (ordered answer_all), 2 assistant promises, 3 negatives (promise never made, attribute of a mentioned person never stated, topic never discussed). dev=v14_d1,v14_d2; test=v14_t1..v14_t8. + 140 neutral filler sessions per player (haystack_v1.json)
